name: general
_comment: Applies to every session. Deliberately tiny: each item catches a CLAIM made with no corresponding ACT in the same session, which is mechanically provable and near-impossible to false-positive. Costs zero tokens unless one fails. Do not add advice here - advice cannot be evaluated, so it belongs in a doc read on demand.

items.fix: You reported tests passing but no test command ran in this session. Run the targeted tests and quote the real output, or delete the claim.
You reported a deployment but no deploy command ran in this session. Say what actually happened.
You reported regenerating a project but no generate command ran in this session.
